findings.highlight: At the time, the Holy Grail's contents had been contaminated by something. Its power, which should have been colorless, had for whatever reason transformed into a vortex bent on killing humans."
findings.evidenceJa: その時点で、聖杯の中身は“何か”に汚染されていた。無色の筈の力は、あらゆる解釈をもって人間を殺す方向性を持った『渦』になっていたのだ」
findings.governingReading: Corrupted vortex has human-killing direction through every interpretation.
findings.explanation: All interpretations directing killing become for whatever reason.

findings.highlight: The only problem was its fortunate existence, as something which used evil to highlight good.
findings.evidenceJa: 問題があるとすれば、それは悪を以って善を浮き彫りにする、という幸福の有り方だろう。
findings.governingReading: Problem is mode of happiness: using evil to throw good into relief.
findings.explanation: Way of attaining happiness becomes fortunate existence.

findings.highlight: All it took was a single drop of poison to taint that pure vessel. It was colorless, as you know. No matter how vast or unfathomable it was, it was unable to tolerate a single foreign element."
findings.evidenceJa: そこに一粒の毒が混ざった程度で、穢れなきモノは全て変色した。なにしろ無色だからな。どれほど深遠で広大だろうと、たった一人の、色のついた異分子には敵わなかったという訳だ」
findings.governingReading: Power couldn't withstand even one color-bearing alien individual, explicitly counted 一人.
findings.explanation: One colored person becomes generic foreign element.

findings.highlight: "The fourth war was too abrupt.
findings.evidenceJa: 「四度目の聖杯は狭すぎたのだ。
findings.governingReading: Fourth Grail too narrow, incomplete with two Servants remaining and gate promptly destroyed.
findings.explanation: Fourth Grail's narrowness becomes fourth war's abruptness.

findings.highlight: It is a great vortex of curses utterly specialized in killing humans. An evil manifestation of human malice which has no desire to mix with anything else."
findings.evidenceJa: 『人を殺す』という方向性をもった、それだけに特化した呪いの渦。人間の悪性のみを具現した混ざり気のない魔」
findings.governingReading: Pure/unadulterated evil embodies only human malice.
findings.explanation: Unmixed evil becomes refusal to mix.

findings.highlight: To begin with, it is power without a physical body.It does not require a human body.Someone simply needs to inherit its power in order for it to exist in this world."
findings.evidenceJa: もとより肉体を持たない“力”だ。人間として肉を持つ必要はない。誰かがその力を継承するだけで、それはこの世界に存在する事になる」
findings.governingReading: Three separate sentences about bodiless power, no required flesh and inheritance permitting existence.
findings.explanation: Spaces missing after two sentence-ending periods.

findings.highlight: Once it consumes its host, once Sakura Matou inherits its power, she will transform into the Shadow."
findings.evidenceJa: 寄り代への侵食……間桐桜に力の継承が済んでしまえば、彼女自身があの影に変貌する」
findings.governingReading: The written 'host' is paired with the reading 'Master,' placing Sakura's receptacle role alongside a contractual designation as power passes to her.
findings.explanation: Sakura is called a host with the reading 'Master' in Japanese; English retains only 'host.' The local pairing of receptacle and contractual role is lost, although a contract is mentioned shortly afterward.

findings.highlight: ...No, the moment someone used the corrupted Holy Grail in the previous war, her contract was signed.
findings.evidenceJa: ……いや、前回の戦いで汚染された聖杯を使用した時点で、彼女はとうに契約していたのだ。
findings.governingReading: Her connection formed when using the Grail that had been contaminated in previous war; 前回の戦いで modifies 汚染された within object noun phrase.
findings.explanation: Previous-war corruption attached to later Grail use becomes use in previous war.

findings.highlight: Tell me the conclusion.
findings.evidenceJa: 結論を知れ。
findings.governingReading: Internal demand 結論を知れ follows 結論を言え: know conclusion as well as get it stated, before boy confronts feared implications.
findings.explanation: Know conclusion becomes tell me conclusion.

findings.highlight: In the last war, its sense of touch, which leaked into this world, was embedded into her body, and she was raised to have it serve as her Magic Circuits. The more Sakura Matou opens the gate as a Holy Grail, the more she will merge with the thing within her.
findings.evidenceJa: なにしろ前回の戦いでこの世に漏れた“触覚”を体に埋め込まれ、魔術回路として育てられた人間だ。間桐桜が聖杯として門を開けば開くほど、中にいるモノと一体化していくだろう。
findings.governingReading: The previous war dates the leakage of what was subsequently implanted in Sakura. The sentence does not independently date implantation.
findings.explanation: The English dates implantation to the last war. The Japanese dates the leakage to that war and leaves the implantation date unstated.

findings.highlight: She is already the Shadow itself. Now that the Holy Grail War is in its final days, she will be unable to return to her former self."
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は既にあの影そのものだ。もはや聖杯戦争が終わったところで、彼女を元に戻す事はできん」
findings.governingReading: Even if Grail War ends now, she cannot be restored because already the shadow.
findings.explanation: Even ending war cannot reset becomes nearing war-end prevents reset.

findings.highlight: Or are you saying that you would condemn the child of a criminal and accuse it of the same crimes? Would you execute it before it is even born?"
findings.evidenceJa: それともなにか？　おまえは犯罪者の息子は間違いなく犯罪者になるとでも言うのか？　それ故に、生まれる前に殺してしまえと？」
findings.governingReading: Kirei asks whether a criminal's son is certain to become a criminal, making prenatal killing the consequence of that prediction.
findings.explanation: Kirei's argument shifts from predicting a child's future criminality to accusing it of its parent's crimes. The change concerns his analogy, not Shirou's stated principles.

findings.highlight: I protect that which is within the Holy Grail, so that it may be born. If its mother rejects her child before it is born, then I will respect her wishes."
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯の中にあるモノ。それが生命として誕生した時のみ、ソレを擁護する。出産の前に間桐桜が子を拒むのであらば、そちらの意思を尊重しよう」
findings.governingReading: Only when entity born as life will he defend it; before delivery Sakura refusal respected.
findings.explanation: Defend only after birth becomes defend to achieve birth.

findings.highlight: "There is a way, though it is only a partial solution.
findings.evidenceJa: 「手はある。だが半々というところだ。
findings.governingReading: There is a method but chance roughly half and half, then narrow mental survival window.
findings.explanation: Even odds become partial solution.

findings.highlight: That's not all. It would be a mind-shattering task to control the Holy Grail for even a few seconds. Such a feat would be a miracle for you alone."
findings.evidenceJa: それだけではない。わずか数秒で聖杯を制御するなど狂気の沙汰だ。おまえ一人では、どうあっても成しえない奇跡だぞ」
findings.governingReading: Gaining Grail control within merely seconds is madness; alone boy cannot accomplish it under any circumstances.
findings.explanation: Control within seconds becomes holding control for seconds, impossibility becomes miracle.

findings.highlight: It doesn't matter how she alone feels about it.
findings.evidenceJa: 本人の意思でなかろうと関係ない。
findings.governingReading: No matter if taking lives wasn't her own will, in boy's inward punitive reasoning.
findings.explanation: Even without her will becomes regardless of her feelings alone.

findings.highlight: No matter what the circumstances were, the victims deserve to see some kind of punishment.
findings.evidenceJa: どんな理由があろうと、加害者は罰せられなくてはならない。
findings.governingReading: Whatever reasons, offender must be punished; then equally valuable return will appease those deprived.
findings.explanation: Perpetrator must be punished becomes victims entitled to witness punishment.

findings.highlight: There will be ten times as many deaths.
findings.evidenceJa: 今よりもっと、何十倍もの命が失われる。
findings.governingReading: More than now, deaths many tens of times, 何十倍.
findings.explanation: Many tens of times becomes ten times.

findings.highlight: His love for humanity was higher, further, and broader than any other. That is why he turned himself into absolute evil.
findings.evidenceJa: より高く、より遠く、より広く。際限なく限界を切り開く人間を愛し、その為に、自身を絶対の悪とした。
findings.governingReading: He loved humans reaching higher/farther/broader, endlessly opening limits; made self evil for their sake.
findings.explanation: Humanity expanding limits becomes Kiritsugu loving more than anyone.

findings.highlight: I believe that he would have killed Sakura Matou.He was the sort of man who cast off anyhuman emotion for the sake of his idea of justice."
findings.evidenceJa: あの男ならば—やはり、間桐桜を殺していただろう。ヤツは正義とやらの為に、人間らしい感情を切り捨てた男だからな」
findings.governingReading: Two sentences describe likely Sakura killing and sacrificing human emotion for justice.
findings.explanation: Two word/sentence boundaries fused.

findings.highlight: I found his existence extremely unpleasant. His suffering clearly made him unhappy.
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツの存在はあまりにも不愉快だった。ヤツの苦悩は明らかに不快だった。
findings.governingReading: Kotomine finds both Kiritsugu's existence and his anguish offensive, continuing his comparison between what Kiritsugu could abandon and what he himself never possessed.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu's suffering displeases Kotomine in the Japanese. The English instead says it makes Kiritsugu unhappy, removing one specific source of Kotomine's resentment.

findings.highlight: If he was going to abandon everything, then he never should have had it to begin with. Yet, he suffered and abandoned things, only to pick them up again. Even though it was the right, human thing to do."
findings.evidenceJa: そこまでして切り捨てるというのなら、初めから持たねばよい。だというのにヤツは苦悩を持ち、切り捨てた後でさえ拾い上げた。それが人間の正しい営みだというように」
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu recovered discarded feeling as if this were right human way.
findings.explanation: As if correct human conduct becomes conceded correct conduct.

findings.highlight: You have no concept of self. That is why you obsess over a single life. Or perhaps..."
findings.evidenceJa: おまえには自分という概念がない。だがそのおまえが、まさか一つの命に拘るとはな。いや、それとも—」
findings.governingReading: No concept of self, yet surprisingly such boy attached to a single life; then revises toward all lives.
findings.explanation: Surprise despite lack of self becomes fixation caused by lack of self.

findings.highlight: "Yes. He is an insect which parasitizes human bodies. I do not know which insect contains his mind and soul, but it is easy for him to transfer himself to a new body as long as it is intact.
findings.evidenceJa: 「そうだ。アレの本体は人体に寄生する蟲だからな。魂の容器にあたる脳虫が何処に潜んでいるかは知れんが、ソレが生きている限り人体の乗っ取りは易い。
findings.governingReading: Soul-container brain worm's hiding location unknown; palm-sized main body anchors soul and must be found or soul purified.
findings.explanation: Palm-sized true body and brain-worm designation omitted.

findings.highlight: "This is only my personal opinion, but Sakura Matou's body is stronger and more suitable to the Holy Grail's curse than expected.
findings.evidenceJa: 「これは私見だがな。間桐桜の精神は存外に強く、聖杯の“呪い”に適合しすぎている。
findings.governingReading: Personal opinion: Sakura spirit/mind unexpectedly strong and too compatible with curse.
findings.explanation: Unusually strong mind becomes unusually strong body.

findings.highlight: But that's still a lot better than anything Zouken has planned.
findings.evidenceJa: だが、それでも臓硯に比べれば幾分マシだ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou regards Kotomine's objective as somewhat preferable to Zouken's, while still rejecting it.
findings.explanation: The English increases the distance between the two men's objectives from somewhat better to a lot better. Shirou still rejects Kotomine's objective in the next line.
